items.title: FDA's rare disease framework faces its first real test in Capricor’s DMD drug
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Last month, the FDA committed to designing a "fit-for-purpose" framework for regulating rare disease therapies based on patient need and realistically attainable evidence. With the upcoming decision for Capricor’s Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy deramiocel, this paradigm faces its first key test.

items.title: Coherus cuts 30% of staffers, Gyre makes post-acquisition layoffs
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Coherus is narrowing its pipeline projects while Gyre reorganizes after an acquisition, with both biotechs conducting workforce reductions.

items.title: BIO pitches US plan to beat China in biotech ‘space race’
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The seven proposals in the Bio Advance plan include easing clinical trial starts, boosting manufacturing and establishing a new White House office to coordinate the government’s biotech policy.

items.title: Beam preps FDA run for industry-first base-edited therapy after pivotal sickle cell success
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Beam Therapeutics' risto-cel provided at least 12 consecutive months of freedom from severe pain crises for patients with sickle cell disease in a mid-stage trial, setting the stage for an FDA application as early as this year.

items.title: Bayer wins first-in-class FDA nod for blood thinner, setting stage for BMS-J&J rival
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Bayer’s Sunharbo has secured the first FDA approval of its class, establishing a regulatory pathway for other factor XIa inhibitors, such as Bristol Myers Squibb and Johnson and Johnson’s milvexian.

items.title: Delix raises $100M to advance at-home psychedelic without hallucinogenic effects
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The series C raise, co-led by Johnson & Johnson’s venture capital arm, will help Delix Therapeutics push its novel psychedelic asset into mid-stage development for major depressive disorder.

items.title: Altimmune gears up for FDA meeting on pivotal Phase 3 trial in alcohol use disorder
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Having linked its glucagon/GLP-1 candidate to a significant reduction in heavy drinking days, Altimmune is preparing to speak to the FDA in December about the design of a Phase 3 program.

items.title: PepGen soars on promising early data for muscular dystrophy drug
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): While from a small study, the findings suggest PepGen’s therapy compares favorably to other RNA-based medicines in testing at Novartis and Dyne Therapeutics.

items.title: Beam’s base editing therapy for sickle cell hits goal in pivotal trial
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The result represents a scientific milestone and positions Beam to submit a first-of-its-kind FDA application as soon as the end of the year.
